title: Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay procedure at higher temperature enhances speed of the assay
protocol: Activate the polystyrene surface by coating with FNAB.
Expose the coated wells to UV light for 15 minutes at a wavelength of 365 nm.
Immobilize the capture molecule (anti-human IgG or anti-human IgE) onto the activated polystyrene plates.
Block the plate to prevent non-specific binding.
Add the analyte (human IgG or human IgE) and allow it to bind.
Wash the plate after adding the analyte.
Add a secondary antibody-conjugate to detect bound analyte.
Wash the plate again after adding the secondary antibody-conjugate.
Add substrate-dye buffer to develop color.
Stop the reaction by adding 20 μl of 5% sulfuric acid.
